about: Recorded baseline for scripts/check-static-baseline.mjs. Regenerate one gate with `node scripts/check-static-baseline.mjs <build|lint> --update`; raising a count or adding a key also requires --allow-increase. Delete this file and this script, and restore the plain npm scripts in the frontend CI job, once the warnings listed here are cleared too.
